decision.rationale: Official UBC Ethnographic Film Unit homepage identifies an anthropological digital video production unit in Vancouver, with useful research, community documentary projects, courses, services and event information. Route observed academic, support, festival and news sections separately from the research-focused host purpose; no distinct stories section is evidenced.

rules.rationale: The homepage presents community documentary projects as the work of the anthropological research unit.
The observed Courses section provides academic teaching information.
The Film Unit Festival section identifies a film-related participation opportunity.
Homepage News and Events navigation and dated annual festival posts identify announcements and event updates.
Services, Facilities, Ordering Videos and Links provide practical resources and access to unit services.

fallback.rationale: The Ethnographic Film Unit focuses on anthropological film production and research with community documentary projects.
